datasets.retrieval_method: Kaggle's public dataset-preview API (GetDataViewExternal), read via browser session -- the file_download button requires a logged-in Kaggle account, which was not available in this environment. All 99 rows were retrieved in two API pages (50 + 49) and verified against the file's own totalRows=99 metadata from GetDatabundleExternal before saving.

datasets.used_for: Seed training data for the fertilizer-type classifier (contract C4 CLASSIFIER_TARGET). Quantity and schedule come from ml/data/external/reference_doses.csv and split_schedule.csv (PAU-sourced), not from this dataset.

datasets.description: SYNTHETIC classifier-training supplement -- generated, not observed. Supplements (does not replace) the real 99-row fertilizer_prediction dataset above.
datasets.generation_method: ml/src/data_pipeline/generate_synthetic_data.py -- every value is grounded in an already-sourced table in this repo (seasonal_weather.csv's real Open-Meteo monthly Punjab averages for temperature/humidity, soil_test_ratings.csv's ICAR-IISS bands for N/P/K, reference_doses.csv + soil_adjustments.csv for the fertilizer LABEL, computed per-row from that row's own generated soil values, never assigned independently). moisture_pct's band is a documented team assumption -- no per-month real moisture source exists in this repo, unlike temperature/humidity. Product sampling applies a flat bonus to priced products' similarity score (fertilizer_products.csv's price_inr_per_kg not TODO) per Saloni's DATA_REQUIREMENTS.md, so the label distribution leans toward products that can actually produce a usable cost/schedule end-to-end, without ever overriding a genuinely much better-matching unpriced grade.

units.Nitrogen: kg/ha (Soil Health Card basis) -- unlike the real file, units are confirmed here since this script generated them that way deliberately

datasets.used_for: Supplements the real 99-row seed for the fertilizer-type classifier. Labelled synthetic everywhere it's used (this manifest, data_source column added by clean.py, ml/data/README.md) so it can never be mistaken for a real field observation.

datasets.description: Real SOTER soil-profile estimates for the Indo-Gangetic Plains (includes Punjab), 0-20cm depth
datasets.retrieval_method: Direct download of the public ISRIC SOTWIS_IGP-IN.zip archive; attribute table extracted from GIS/SOTWIS/SOTWIS_0-20cm_parametersestimates/IGP-IN_SOTWISv1_t1s1d1.dbf with dbfread. Geometry/shapefile discarded -- only the tabular soil-property attributes were kept.
datasets.used_for: Complementary reference only -- cross-checking realistic soil parameter ranges (pH, organic carbon proxy via total_carbon_pct, N%, EC) for the Punjab/Indo-Gangetic-Plains region. Polygon/map-unit level (1:1,000,000 scale), not per-field; not used as classifier training rows. Not filtered to Punjab specifically -- covers the whole Indo-Gangetic Plains (497 SOTER units), which includes Punjab but is not exclusive to it.

evaluated_not_ingested.description: IFA/FAO Fertilizer Use by Crop (FUBC) 2017-18 survey + historical collation, includes India (rice/wheat/cotton/sugarcane) at country level
evaluated_not_ingested.reason_not_ingested: License and structure fully verified (peer-reviewed in Nature Scientific Data, DOI 10.1038/s41597-022-01592-z), but the raw CSV download is behind an anti-bot challenge (Anubis/BotStopper) that this session's tools could not mechanically pass, and the in-browser preview truncates before reaching India alphabetically in the country-sorted file. Rather than fabricate India rows, this was left unfetched. Recommend a manual download by a teammate in a normal browser session for R3/R10 norm cross-checking.
